children: Apple Inc. Chief Executive Officer John Ternus touted the company’s strong product pipeline and teased a “phenomenal” iPhone launch next week in his first remarks to employees as their new leader.

The CEO, who was previously head of hardware engineering, said that he’s excited about what “lies beyond” the new iPhone release, “including the incredible products already in the works and the ones we haven’t even imagined yet that we’ll dream up and create together.”
He also thanked his predecessor, Tim Cook, for his leadership at Apple and his help during the transition. Cook, who ran Apple for 15 years, is staying on as executive chairman.
Also on Tuesday, Ternus posted on X for the first time, joining Cook and marketing chief Greg Joswiak among Apple executives who are active on the social media platform.
Joswiak said that Ternus would have more to say at the company’s Sept. 9 event. Apple is planning to launch its first foldable iPhone and is readying a push into smart home devices.
Further out, Apple’s road map includes AirPods with cameras, smart glasses, a tabletop robot home device and a touch-screen MacBook, Bloomberg News has reported.
Cook sent his final note to employees as CEO on Monday, telling them that he’ll miss the work but is confident in Ternus’ leadership.
Here is Ternus’ memo to staff in full:

Today, on my first day as CEO, I just wanted to send a quick note to thank everyone for the warm wishes. I also want to extend my deep appreciation to Tim for sharing so much of his knowledge and experience during this transition, and more importantly, for everything he contributed to Apple over the years. We’re so lucky to have had a CEO who led with his values and with such decency and humanity. We are all better for it and I’m so grateful he’ll be our executive chairman.

I’m honoured to be stepping into this role at what is truly the greatest company in the world, and I am so excited about everything we have in store. We have a huge launch next week that’s going to be phenomenal. Thanks for everything you’ve all done to make it possible.

I’m just as excited about what lies beyond that, including the incredible products already in the works and the ones we haven’t even imagined yet that we’ll dream up and create together. There’s no team in the world I’d rather build the future with.
More to come. In the meantime, thanks for your excellent work!

title: Apple’s new CEO John Ternus touts product pipeline, ‘phenomenal’ iPhone launch in memo
